culprit_citations.quoted_text: Lynx BidCo (3)(4) | First-lien loan ($ 43,487 par, due 7/2031) | 7/5/2024 | SOFR + 6.25% | 9.95%

findings.detail: The USD Lynx spread was stored as 6.50% but the source row states SOFR + 6.25%.
The EUR Lynx spread was stored as 6.50% but the source row states E + 6.25%.

rationale: Class 2 review of the full Lynx BidCo rows localizes the defect to the extracted spread. The raw March 31, 2026 schedule states 6.25% for both the USD and EUR instruments, whereas the flagged extracted identifiers state 6.50%. The interest rates, par amounts, dates, costs, and fair values otherwise align, so the reconciliation flag reflects a real 0.25 percentage-point spread extraction error rather than a bad check.
